title: Clear
subtitle: 清楚，究竟是哪一種「明顯」？
description: 清楚，究竟是哪一種「明顯」？

words.note: 最直接、最常用的近義詞之一，表示很容易看出、理解或察覺，不需要太多推理。
words.example: It was obvious that the machine had not been maintained properly.
words.exampleZh: 很明顯，這部機器沒有得到妥善保養。

exercises.original: It was clear that the machine had not been maintained properly.
exercises.zh: 很明顯，這部機器沒有得到妥善保養。
exercises.upgrade: obvious · 明顯的；顯而易見的

options.explanation: hidden = hidden 表示被隱藏，和容易看出相反。
uncertain = uncertain 表示不確定，和明顯不合。
obvious = 機器狀況一看便能判斷缺乏保養，因此 obvious 是最直接的近義詞。
visible = visible 只表示看得見；本句需要的是結論容易判斷。
simple = simple 表示不複雜，不等於顯而易見。
oblivious = oblivious 表示沒有察覺，和 obvious 意思完全不同。

words.note: 表示事實或情況很清楚、容易看出，常見於 plain to see、make it plain 等表達。

words.note: 較正式，表示有足夠跡象或證據讓某事變得清楚可見。

falseSynonyms.zh: 看得見不等於明顯 visible 只表示能看見；某物即使可見，也未必容易理解或察覺其意義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The sign is visible, but its meaning is not immediately clear.

falseSynonyms.zh: 簡單不等於清楚 simple 表示不複雜；一件簡單的事情仍可能解釋得不清楚。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The process is simple, but the instructions are not clear.

falseSynonyms.zh: 確定不等於明顯 certain 表示有把握或確定；clear 在這裡主要表示容易看出或理解。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I am certain about the answer because the evidence is clear.

falseSynonyms.zh: 透明不一定等於清楚 transparent 可指物理上透明，也可比喻公開；不能一般地替代『明顯、顯而易見』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The glass is transparent. The reason is clear.

falseSynonyms.zh: 明亮不等於清楚 bright 表示光線強或色彩鮮明；和事實是否明顯不是同一概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The room is bright, but the instructions are unclear.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與副詞不同 clear 是形容詞；clearly 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The message is clear. She explained it clearly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與形容詞不同 clarity 是清晰度；clear 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The report lacks clarity. Its conclusion is not clear.

falseSynonyms.zh: 字形相似但意思完全不同 obvious 是明顯的；oblivious 是沒有察覺的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The mistake was obvious. He was oblivious to it.
